# Per-source scope concepts

Generated by Codex on behalf of Adrien Conrath using the built-in ChatGPT image generation tool. These are AI-generated concepts, not implemented product screenshots. All example data is fictional.

These assets illustrate the per-source access boundary design discussion. They are hosted on a dedicated discussion-assets branch, not integrated into the application. Provider marks identify the proposed source integrations and do not imply endorsement.
